name: Jörg Haider
bio: Jörg Haider (1950–2008) was an Austrian far-right politician, FPÖ leader from 1986 to 2000 and a founder of the BZÖ in 2005. He governed Carinthia in 1989–1991 and 1999–2008. His political record includes restrictive immigration campaigns and conflict with the Constitutional Court over Slovene-language place-name signs. He died in a road crash on 11 October 2008.
